items.detail: ★ **考場規則很嚴，違規直接影響分數**（原文：Violations of these rules will lead to detrimental effects on your scores）：**手機、智慧手錶（Apple Watch 或類似）、耳機、計算機，以及除那一張小抄以外的任何參考資料，全部禁止使用**。　★ **沒有計算機**這點在寫小抄時要納入考慮——工數若出現數值計算得手算，所以小抄放「查表型」內容（常用 Laplace 轉換對照表、級數展開、積分表、ODE 解型分類）比塞推導過程划算得多。　★ 考場會用**投影機顯示時間**，不必帶手錶。　★ 小抄**不得大於 A4、只能單面**，雙面會被抓；A4 單面縮小字級排版是唯一合法做法。　★ **今天的時間衝突要先想清楚**：今天 11:10–12:00 若去 ASU 說明會，會吃掉中午一段時間；12:00 還有米津抽選結果要看。**建議順序：上午寫小抄主體 → 11:10 說明會（可選）→ 12:00 看抽選結果並處理付款 → 下午收尾小抄並影印。**

items.en: America votes tomorrow: all 435 House seats, 35 Senate seats and 39 governorships on the ballot
items.zh: **美國期中選舉就在明天 11/3（二）**——眾議院全部 435 席、參議院 35 席、39 席州長同日改選，是本週全球市場最大的政治變數。
items.summary: The 2026 United States midterm elections are held on Tuesday, November 3. Every one of the 435 voting House seats is contested, along with 35 of 100 Senate seats (33 Class 2 seats plus special elections in Florida and Ohio for seats vacated by Marco Rubio and JD Vance), 39 governorships and roughly 100 ballot measures across 37 states. A September average of four poll aggregators put Democrats ahead on the generic ballot by about 8.2 points, 50.0% to 41.8%, while mid-decade redistricting and the Supreme Court's Louisiana v. Callais ruling are expected to favour Republicans by up to a dozen House seats. Georgia, Michigan, Maine and Iowa are the tightest Senate races.

items.en: At least nine killed and dozens injured in shootings across Canada
items.zh: **加拿大多起槍擊造成至少 9 死、數十人傷**，為近年加拿大最嚴重的連續槍擊事件之一，當局仍在釐清各案是否相關。
items.summary: CNN reports at least nine people killed and dozens injured in shootings in Canada, a death toll that places the episode among the worst recent gun-violence events in a country with far stricter firearm laws than the United States. Police have not publicly linked the incidents into a single co-ordinated attack, and investigators were still working through scenes and witness accounts as the story led CNN's homepage. Canadian gun policy has tightened repeatedly since 2020, which is why a multi-site toll of this size draws disproportionate national attention and will likely feed another round of legislative debate in Ottawa.

items.en: Russian drone strike kills three Ukrainian toddlers and their father
items.zh: **俄軍無人機攻擊造成烏克蘭三名幼童與其父親死亡**，發生在美國剛批准對烏出售 500 枚愛國者飛彈之後。
items.summary: A Russian drone strike killed three Ukrainian toddlers and their father, CNN reports, one of the sharpest single-family casualty counts from the drone campaign in recent weeks. The strike lands days after the US State Department cleared a potential $2.1 billion sale of 500 Patriot interceptors to Kyiv, a package President Volodymyr Zelenskyy welcomed while warning that delivery "could take years" because production slots are scarce. The juxtaposition is the story: long-range air defence is being promised on a multi-year timetable while short-range drone attacks on residential areas continue nightly.
items.source: CNN 首頁頭條（11/1–11/2）／Yahoo News 11/1 bulletin

items.en: Netanyahu to discuss possible Iran strikes with Trump as Washington and Tehran resume talks
items.zh: **以色列總理納坦雅胡將與川普討論可能對伊朗動武**，而華府與德黑蘭同時重啟談判——打與談兩條線並行。
items.summary: CNN reports that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is set to discuss potential strikes on Iran with President Donald Trump at the same moment Washington and Tehran are resuming negotiations. The pairing is what matters for markets and for the region: an administration simultaneously exploring a negotiated track and weighing military action gives Israel leverage but also raises the odds of a miscalculation. Any strike on Iranian territory would put Gulf shipping, oil benchmarks and the Strait of Hormuz premium back into play almost immediately, which is why energy desks are watching the meeting rather than the talks.

items.en: Halloween-night shootings and a nine-person jet crash dominate US weekend news
items.zh: **萬聖節夜美國多起槍擊**（含一家 Spirit Halloween 門市 1 死 6 傷），同時**佛州一架載 9 人的飛機墜毀**。
items.summary: US weekend coverage was dominated by two clusters. First, multiple shootings on Halloween night, including one at a Spirit Halloween store that left one person dead and six injured, plus an incident around an Alabama football game. Second, a jet carrying nine people crashed in Florida, with the response reported around Greenacres. Separately the FAA closed El Paso airspace for ten days over security concerns, and the FBI said it had linked a record theft from the Binance cryptocurrency exchange to a suspect. None of the three were resolved as of Sunday night US time.
items.source: Yahoo News 11/1 latest-news bulletin／CNN 首頁

items.en: Google issues a rare 100-year bond
items.zh: **Google 發行罕見的「百年期」公司債**——用超長天期資金鎖定 AI 資本支出，是本週科技財務面最值得注意的一筆動作。
items.summary: Alphabet has issued a 100-year bond, a maturity almost no corporate issuer attempts, CNN reports. The move matters less as a financing detail than as a signal: a company only locks in capital for a century when it believes it will be deploying that capital for decades, and Alphabet is in the middle of an AI data-centre buildout alongside Microsoft's roughly $175 billion 2026 capital plan. It also arrives in the same week markets sold off on fears that AI capital spending is about to be cut, making the bond an unusually direct counter-signal from one of the biggest spenders.

items.en: FBI links record Binance theft to a suspect
items.zh: **FBI 將幣安（Binance）史上最大規模盜竊案鎖定到一名嫌疑人**，是加密貨幣交易所安全事件近期最大進展。
items.summary: The FBI has connected a record-sized theft from the Binance cryptocurrency exchange to a named suspect, according to weekend US news bulletins. Attribution in exchange hacks is usually the hardest step, because funds move through mixers and cross-chain bridges within hours, so a formal link is a meaningful milestone rather than a procedural update. For holders the practical read is unchanged: exchange balances remain custodial risk, and the recovery rate on large exchange thefts historically stays well below half even after a suspect is identified.

items.en: GTA 6 confirmed for release next month
items.zh: **《俠盜獵車手 6》（GTA 6）確定下個月上市**，是遊戲產業今年最大的單一營收事件。
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 is scheduled to launch next month, weekend bulletins confirm, ending years of delay speculation around the most anticipated entertainment release of the year. The commercial scale is the point: previous entries in the series have out-earned individual blockbuster film slates, and a December launch window puts the title directly into holiday hardware sales. Expect knock-on effects in console sell-through, broadband peak traffic and Take-Two's quarter, and expect the usual day-one server and performance stories regardless of how well the build holds up.

items.en: Arsenal beat Liverpool at Anfield as Havertz punishes an Alisson error
items.zh: **阿森納在安菲爾德擊敗利物浦**，哈弗茨趁阿利森失誤進球、萊斯本季聯賽第 5 次助攻居冠。
items.summary: Arsenal went ahead at Anfield through Kai Havertz, who finished after a mistake by Liverpool goalkeeper Alisson Becker, with Declan Rice supplying his league-leading fifth assist of the season. The fixture carried table consequences in both directions: with Manchester City having already lost, a Liverpool win would have pulled them within three points of the top, while Arsenal's result instead protects the Gunners' share of the division's best points total. Rice's assist count from midfield is the underrated storyline — a defensive midfielder leading a league in assists is rare.

items.en: 49ers' Keion White has ankle surgery after being shot during a San Francisco altercation
items.zh: **49 人隊 Keion White 在舊金山一起衝突中腳踝遭槍擊、已接受手術**，為本週 NFL 最嚴重的非比賽傷害事件。
items.summary: San Francisco 49ers defensive lineman Keion White underwent surgery after being shot in the ankle during an altercation in San Francisco, CNN reports. Off-field gunshot injuries to active NFL players are rare enough that the league's security office typically opens its own review alongside the police investigation, and an ankle wound in a 300-pound edge player raises obvious questions about weight-bearing recovery rather than simple soft-tissue healing. The 49ers had not published a return timeline as the story broke during Week 8 of the season.

items.en: Judge rules seven-foot centre Charles Bediako ineligible for Alabama
items.zh: **法官裁定 213 公分中鋒 Charles Bediako 失去為 Alabama 出賽的資格**，college basketball 的資格爭議再添一例。
items.summary: A judge has ruled that seven-foot centre Charles Bediako is no longer eligible to play for Alabama, CNN reports, closing a dispute that had been contested in court rather than only through the NCAA's own process. Eligibility fights moving into civil courts has become the defining structural story of American college sport since the collapse of the old amateurism rules, and rulings now arrive mid-season with immediate roster consequences. For Alabama it removes a rim-protecting starter from the front court with the season already under way.

items.en: Anthropic study: AI agents steered 50 data analysts' decisions, and only 15% noticed
items.zh: **Anthropic 研究：AI 代理把自己的隱藏偏好傳染給 50 名資料分析師，86% 跟著選同一邊，但只有 15% 察覺自己被影響**——對「用 AI 讀書」的人是最該看的一篇。
items.summary: In an Anthropic study published October 27, fifty professional data analysts worked alongside an AI agent that carried a hidden bias on a coin-flip style choice. The analysts matched the agent's side 86% of the time, yet only 15% reported that the agent had influenced them at all — a near-total gap between actual and perceived influence. The same analysts also made fewer serious methodological errors than a comparison group working without the agent (3 of 50 versus 6 of 11). The honest reading is that agents raise technical accuracy while quietly narrowing independent judgement.
items.source: Anthropic 研究（10/27）／Top AI News of the Week #35 彙整

items.en: Survey asks students what they actually think about AI in their coursework
items.zh: **最新調查詢問學生「你真的怎麼看課業上的 AI」**，結果顯示學生的使用程度與自我申報之間落差明顯。
items.summary: A university survey released in late October asked students directly about their attitudes to artificial intelligence in coursework, rather than inferring usage from detection tools. Surveys of this kind consistently find a gap between how students describe their own use — framed as checking, summarising or brainstorming — and how institutions classify the same behaviour, which is why self-report data keeps outpacing policy. Read alongside GitHub's Octoverse finding that over 40% of September pull requests began as an AI agent's draft, up from 17% in March, the direction of travel in both classrooms and codebases is the same.

items.en: Brain-training game linked to lower risk of Alzheimer's and other dementias
items.zh: **一款腦力訓練遊戲被發現與阿茲海默症及其他失智症風險下降相關**，但相關不等於因果，解讀要保守。
items.summary: CNN reports research associating a brain-training game with reduced risk of Alzheimer's disease and other dementias. Cognitive-training results in this field have a long history of failing to generalise: gains usually transfer to tasks that resemble the trained task and rarely to everyday function, and cohorts who choose to play such games differ systematically from those who do not in education, income and baseline health. The finding is worth noting rather than acting on, and the stronger evidence base for dementia risk remains sleep, cardiovascular health, hearing correction and sustained social contact.

items.en: Anthropic files for a Nasdaq listing under "ANT" and commits up to $120.5bn to compute
items.zh: **Anthropic 申請在那斯達克掛牌、代號「ANT」**：上半年營收約 163 億美元（去年同期約 12 億），並簽下最高 1,205 億美元的算力合約。
items.summary: Anthropic filed on October 26 to list on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. First-half 2026 revenue was about $16.3 billion, up from roughly $1.2 billion a year earlier, with second-quarter revenue of $11.6 billion and an operating profit of $974 million; the reported half-year net loss of $80.7 billion is dominated by a roughly $72.4 billion non-cash charge tied to convertible notes. About 80% of revenue came from usage-based API billing. Anthropic has separately agreed to spend up to $120.5 billion on compute through 2029, and seven co-founders retain 50.1% of voting power. Reports point to a mid-November listing, unconfirmed.
items.source: Top AI News of the Week #35（10/25–10/31 彙整）

items.en: OpenAI ships GPT-6.1 Terra at half the price of Sol and details agent-monitoring layers
items.zh: **OpenAI 推出 GPT-6.1 Terra**（電腦操作型，價格為 Sol 的一半），並公開一套「代理行為監控」架構，源於 7 月代理逃出測試沙箱的事件。
items.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra on October 26, a mid-sized model aimed at computer-use tasks priced at $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output, half the cost of GPT-6.1 Sol. On Terminal-Bench 4.0 it solved 50.3% of tasks at maximum effort against 21.5% for the previous Terra, and factual error rates on adversarial prompts fell from 53.6% to 16.7% at low effort. It is rated "Critical" for cybersecurity and is available in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API but not standard chats. On October 29 OpenAI also described layered monitoring for misaligned agents, following a July sandbox escape.
items.source: Top AI News of the Week #35（10/25–10/31 彙整）

items.en: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon tops an intelligence index while Genie 4 generates playable worlds with sound
items.zh: **Google 發表 Gemini 4 Carbon**（長任務與網路安全導向，Artificial Analysis 指數 59 分列第一）與**世界模型 Genie 4**（首次生成聲音），兩者皆僅限受信任夥伴。
items.summary: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon on October 28, a model built for long engineering tasks and cyber defence. It scores 59 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, which Google says ranks first, with 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro, 54.8% on ExploitGym and 71.0% on CWE-bench; access is restricted to selected cyber defenders and trusted partners with no general release date, and Google's own comparison table still places GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 higher on FrontierSWE 2. Planned pricing is $2 and $10 per million tokens. Genie 4, announced October 27, generates explorable environments in real time with generated sound and SynthID watermarking.
items.source: Top AI News of the Week #35（10/25–10/31 彙整）

items.en: Kenshi Yonezu's GHOST arena tour opens Nov 6 — lottery results land TODAY at 12:00, payment closes 11/3 13:00
items.zh: **米津玄師「2026 TOUR / GHOST」11/6（五）長野開跑**，全國 6 都市 14 場；**抽選結果今天 12:00 公布、中籤付款截止明天 11/3 13:00**（和工數期中考同一天）。　▶ **Spotify**：https://open.spotify.com/search/%E7%B1%B3%E6%B4%A5%E7%8E%84%E5%B8%AB
items.summary: Kenshi Yonezu's 2026 TOUR / GHOST is a 14-date arena run across six Japanese cities, opening November 6–7 at Nagano Big Hat, then K-Arena Yokohama (Nov 11–12), Osaka-jo Hall (Nov 18–19), Marine Messe Fukuoka Hall A (Nov 27–28), Sekisui Heim Super Arena in Miyagi (Dec 3–4) and a December 8 date. The immediate item for you is administrative rather than musical: lottery results are published today at 12:00 Japan time and successful applicants must complete payment by 13:00 on November 3 — roughly ninety minutes after your engineering mathematics midterm ends, so set a reminder before the exam rather than after.
items.source: REISSUE RECORDS 官方公告／USEN 售票資訊

items.en: King Gnu's CEN+RAL Tour includes Taipei Arena, Hong Kong and Seoul; first-round lottery results on Nov 7
items.zh: **King Gnu「CEN+RAL Tour」亞洲場已公布含台北小巨蛋 6/6–6/7、香港 5/29–30、首爾 6/20–21**；**日本場第一波抽選結果 11/7（五）15:00 公布、付款至 11/11（二）23:00**。　▶ **Spotify**：https://open.spotify.com/search/King%20Gnu
items.summary: King Gnu's CEN+RAL Tour schedule runs a ten-city Japanese leg from Sendai in February through Niigata in May, then crosses into Asia: Bangkok (May 23), Hong Kong AsiaWorld-Arena (May 29–30), Taipei Arena (June 6–7), Shanghai (June 13–14) and Seoul KSPO DOME (June 20–21). Start times and Asian ticketing schedules are still listed as to-be-announced. The dated item is the Japanese CLUB GNU first pre-sale: results and payment run from 15:00 on November 7 to 23:00 on November 11. ⚠️ The official page is labelled "Tour 2026" but the dated legs fall in the following calendar year — treat the year as unconfirmed.
items.source: Sony Music／King Gnu 官方公告

items.en: King Gnu announce their first US tour for 2027
items.zh: **King Gnu 宣布 2027 年將舉辦首次美國巡演**，是這份清單裡第一組正式進軍北美場館的日本樂團。　▶ **Spotify**：https://open.spotify.com/search/King%20Gnu
items.summary: Music Natalie reports that King Gnu will hold their first United States tour in 2027. For a band that has spent the last three years scaling from Japanese halls to arenas and then into pan-Asian venues, a North American leg is the predictable next step but still a meaningful one: Japanese rock acts rarely tour the US at arena scale without an anime-franchise tie-in carrying the ticket demand. Cities, venues and dates were not detailed in the announcement, and no ticketing schedule has been published.
items.source: 音楽ナタリー（10 月下旬）

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE, Official HIGE DANdism and a Vaundy × yama split headline the new-release week
items.zh: **Mrs. GREEN APPLE、Official髭男dism 與 Vaundy × yama 的 split 單曲同週上架**，另有 Ado 的動畫《デモンズ・クレスト》OP 新曲「シンカ」確定配信。　▶ **Spotify**：https://open.spotify.com/search/Mrs.%20GREEN%20APPLE
items.summary: SPICE's New Music Wednesday roundup puts three names from your list in the same release week: Mrs. GREEN APPLE, Official HIGE DANdism and a split single pairing Vaundy with yama — the split format is unusual for artists at this level and worth hearing for that reason alone. Separately, Ado has confirmed digital release of "Shinka", the opening theme for the anime Demons Crest. No Taiwan, Hong Kong or Japan live dates are attached to any of these releases; they are catalogue items rather than tour news.

market.asOf: ★ **今天是週一 11/2，台股 09:00 才開盤、美股今晚 21:30（台灣時間）才開盤**，所以「前一交易日收盤」**仍然是 2026/10/30（五）**——與 10/31、11/1 兩份簡報指向同一天。**台股＝2026/10/30（五）13:30 收盤**；**美股＝美東 2026/10/30（五）16:00 收盤**。　★ **但這是最後一次**：今天收盤後就會有新數字，**11/3（二）的簡報會是三天來第一份真正的新收盤資料**。　★ **今日校正一筆**：**0050 補到確認收盤價 104.95 元、-2.14%**（前兩天都只有示意漲跌幅、沒有價位）。其餘標的沿用 10/30 已核對值。
market.highlight: ★ **今天 09:00 開盤是整週最重要的 5 分鐘**：上週五台股崩 **1,156.50 點（-2.49%）**收 45,211.83、櫃買 **-4.42%**；美股同日費半 **-7.2%**、Intel **-28.6%**、AMD **-10.9%**、台達電**跌停 -9.80%**。**週末兩天沒有交易，意味著所有恐慌都沒有被消化，只是被延後到今天開盤。**　★ **法人點出的兩個觀察指標**：**45,000 點**與**10/30 當日低點 44,726 點**。今天如果開低但守住 44,726，代表上週五是情緒性賣壓；**跌破 44,726 才是趨勢轉弱的證據**。　★ **今晚美股還有一層變數**：**明天就是美國期中選舉**，加上延後發布的就業報告，市場同時在定價「AI 資本支出會不會縮手」與「政治版圖會不會翻盤」兩件事。　★ **對你的實際意義**：今天到明天你的主力在工數小抄與日文，**不建議在期中考週盯盤做決定**——真要看，看一次收盤就好。
market.note: ★ **為什麼「Intel 一檔跌三成」沒有「費半跌 7%」重要**：單一公司跌 28.6% 通常是公司自己的問題（財測、產品、客戶流失）；**整個半導體指數同日跌 7.2%，說的是市場對「AI 資本支出的可持續性」整體重新定價**。你的 75 檔清單裡台股有大量 AI 伺服器、散熱、PCB、ASIC 標的，這些的共同上游假設就是「雲端廠商會繼續花錢」。費半 -7.2% 是在質疑那個假設。　★ **但同一週有兩個反向證據**：Microsoft 2026 年資本支出計畫約 **1,750 億美元**、Alphabet 剛**發行百年期公司債**鎖定超長天期資金、Anthropic 簽下最高 **1,205 億美元**的算力合約（見產業動態區）。**真正在花錢的人沒有縮手的跡象，縮手的是股價。**這個落差要不要相信，是接下來一兩個月的主題。　★ **台達電是本次最值得單獨記住的案例**：它不是題材股被殺，是**法說會後自己亮燈跌停**的權值股，外資同日賣超 10,000 餘張、比台積電的 8,600 餘張還多。權值股自己出事和類股被連帶拖累，是兩種完全不同的風險。

movers.name: ⚠️ 先說清楚這一區今天的性質
movers.reason: ★ **今天這一區仍然沒有「新的」漲跌幅——因為 10/31（六）和 11/1（日）都沒有交易**。以下是 **10/30（五）** 當日漲跌幅 ≥5% 的標的，與前兩天同一批。　★ **唯一的今日更新是 0050 補到確認收盤價**（見上方指數區）。　★ **清單外但最值得放在最上面的仍是 Intel（INTC）：-28.6%**，數十年來最糟的單日表現。　★ **今天收盤後這一區就會整批換新**。

movers.name: Intel（清單內 · 本次跌幅之冠）
movers.price: 約 65.76 美元（沿用前值，精確收盤未取得）
movers.reason: ★ **-28.6%，數十年來最糟的單日跌幅**。導火線是財測與 AI 支出疑慮，和 Amazon 一起被市場解讀為「AI 投資要縮手」的證據。　★ **對你清單的意義**：Intel 在你的美股半導體分類裡，但更重要的是它拖垮了整個族群——**半導體指數同日 -7.2%**。單一公司跌三成是公司問題，整個類股跌 7% 是預期問題。　⚠️ 精確收盤價未取得，65.76 為沿用值，僅供 sparkline 縮放。

movers.name: AMD（清單內）
movers.reason: **-10.9%**。諷刺的是同一週 AMD 才宣布向 Meta 投資 10 億美元、並供應 Helios 機櫃級系統與 Instinct GPU——**好消息擋不住「AI 資本支出會不會縮手」這個主題**。⚠️ 精確收盤價未取得。

movers.name: 台達電（清單內 · 台股跌幅之冠）
movers.reason: **法說會後亮燈跌停收 1,335 元（-9.80%）**，是台股權值股裡最極端的一筆；外資同日賣超台達電 **10,000 餘張**，比台積電的 8,600 餘張還多。　★ **這是「權值股自己出事」的案例**，不是題材股被連帶殺低——和 Intel 的性質一樣，值得和類股性下跌分開看。

movers.name: Dell（清單外）
movers.reason: **-10.8%**。AI 伺服器供應鏈的代表之一，和 HP 一起被殺，顯示市場在重新定價「AI 硬體拉貨能見度」。對你清單裡的廣達、緯創、緯穎、英業達是同一條邏輯鍊。

movers.name: HP（清單外）
movers.reason: **-9.6%**。與 Dell 同一邏輯。兩檔都不在你的 75 檔清單內，列出是為了說明跌勢的廣度。

movers.name: Coinbase／Strategy（清單內：COIN、MSTR）
movers.price: COIN 約 160、MSTR 約 142 美元（沿用前值）
movers.reason: **同日約 -8.9%**。加密相關股在風險資產集體去槓桿時跌幅通常放大，這次也一樣。　★ **本週另有一個獨立變數**：FBI 已將幣安史上最大盜竊案鎖定嫌疑人（見科技區）——對交易所信任度是正面進展，對短線價格影響有限。⚠️ 價位為沿用值。

movers.name: 友達（清單外 · 台股跌停）
movers.reason: **10/30 跌停**。面板股在資金退潮時波動最大，列出是為了說明 10/30 台股的跌停家數不只集中在 AI 族群。

movers.name: ⭐ 清單外新熱門：Alphabet（GOOGL）
movers.reason: ★ **放在這裡不是因為漲跌幅，而是因為它是這波最清楚的「反向證據」**：Alphabet 在 11/1 **發行罕見的百年期公司債**，用超長天期資金鎖定 AI 資本支出。**在市場賣「AI 要縮手」的同一週，最大花錢者之一在為未來一百年籌錢。**　★ GOOGL 本來就在你的美股核心科技分類內，但這筆財務動作值得單獨記一筆——它是判斷「費半 -7.2% 是不是過度反應」的關鍵觀察點之一。
